note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. The axis is the worse of executable venue depth and primary redemption. Pool TVL is context only and is never substituted for executable depth.

depth.depth_usd_semantics: lower_bound_of_bracket: a size that cleared the threshold, never the crossing itself. Read `bracket` for the located range and `bracket.meets_precision_obligation` for whether it is within 1% of midpoint; a false there with a wide bracket means depth_usd may understate the crossing by the bracket's width.

rung_set.termination_note: The grid was exhausted without crossing the threshold; the figure is a floor, not a located crossing.

depth.slippage_convention: Marginal execution-rate deterioration from the smallest successful $100 rung; signed cost, with -200bps as the crossing threshold. The dated external mid sizes the input notional and is NOT the impact reference.
depth.basis: No depth figure is published: the venue returned the same rate at every tested size, so the largest clearing rung is evidence about the call rather than about the venue.

quote.method: eth_call Curve get_dy(int128,int128,uint256), falling through to get_dy(uint256,uint256,uint256)

anchor.fair_value_source: peg_tracker:CoinGecko API external USD aggregate mid for re-protocol-reusde; off-chain market-data API, distinct from the off-chain issuer NAV API and not a contract read

rungs.quote_expiry_basis: KyberSwap's route response supplies a generation timestamp but no validity deadline. The route is indicative until transaction calldata is built; re-quote immediately before execution.

findings.detail: All failures are above the largest success.
Quote implies -8,144bps against the reference rate. Treat as `invalid_quote`, not as a deep rung -- a successful call is not a valid quote.
Not applicable: no figure to test.

denomination_scope.measured_leg: Ethereum reUSDe -> sUSDe Curve leg only
denomination_scope.excluded_leg: sUSDe -> USD; independent timestamped USD valuation
denomination_scope.exit_cost_scope: The marginal bracket measures deterioration from the venue baseline. Raw token-unit baseline is not a USD discount or all-in cash exit.

primary_exit.gate: Quarterly redemption window; eligibility and released surplus require regulatory approval
primary_exit.capacity_basis: Current remaining holder capacity not measured; historical and announced windows are separate.

first_window.result: Filled to the announced ceiling within 0.005%; requests met or exceeded capacity and the window was rationed.

primary_exit.note: Periodic capped request/claim windows. Announced terms and historical settlement do not establish current entitlement, settlement or continuously available cash.

latest_announced_window.eligibility: Qualifying requestors subject to KYC/jurisdiction restrictions and allocation; current claimant entitlement unknown

enumeration.source: PegTracker reusde_re backing feed plus DexTracker live Curve query
enumeration.chain_count_note: One measured Ethereum secondary venue; this is not asserted to be a complete venue census.
enumeration.live_venue_count_basis: Derived from venues[].is_live. The per-venue field is the single source; this integer is a convenience and cannot disagree with it.

venues.name: Curve REUSDE/sUSDe
venues.balance_ratio_basis: Not published: the token split in this cross-currency twocrypto pool expresses an exchange rate, not a stableswap imbalance or peg signal.
venues.depth_role: The executable ladder is canonical; TVL is context only.
venues.liveness_basis: The single venue this payload's executable Curve get_dy ladder was quoted through.

axis_binding_constraint.basis: Measured marginal Curve depth is a partial exit leg. Primary windows are periodic; current claimant capacity and complete USD exit remain unmeasured.
